tasks.name: Apply prioritization framework to rank items
tasks.description: Use WSJF or MoSCoW to rank backlog items.

tasks.name: Apply version control to documentation set
tasks.description: Apply document versioning controls and version-control the reviewed documentation set. Done when docs are under version control.

tasks.name: Archive completed and de-scoped backlog items
tasks.description: Archive done and de-scoped items with closure rationale for the audit trail.

tasks.name: Archive governance artefacts for audit
tasks.description: Archive governance artefacts in the project record for the audit trail. Done when artefacts are stored.

tasks.name: Archive superseded documentation
tasks.description: Archive superseded documentation with a clear sunset date and replacement reference; done when archived.

tasks.name: Assess technical feasibility
tasks.description: Assess technical feasibility and implementation complexity with the engineering lead. Done when feasibility and complexity findings are documented.

tasks.name: Assign demand for initial assessment
tasks.description: Assign the demand to an accountable product owner and engineering team for initial assessment. Done when owners are assigned.

tasks.name: Audit documentation completeness at release gate
tasks.description: Audit documentation completeness as part of the release governance gate. Done when completeness is confirmed and gate outcome recorded.

tasks.name: Author test cases from acceptance criteria
tasks.description: Write test cases derived from acceptance criteria covering functional scope. Done when cases are authored and reviewed.

tasks.name: Build automated regression suite
tasks.description: Build the automated regression suite and integrate it into the CI pipeline. Done when suite runs automatically on builds.

tasks.name: Build reusable CI/CD pipeline templates
tasks.description: Build reusable CI/CD pipeline templates for squads. Done when templates are published.

tasks.name: Build streaming processor with exactly-once semantics
tasks.description: Build the streaming processor using Kafka Streams, Flink, or Spark Structured Streaming with exactly-once semantics. Done when the processor is built.

tasks.name: Capture and route architecture decision records
tasks.description: Capture architecture decision records and route them to the relevant reviewers. Done when ADRs are recorded and routed.

tasks.name: Capture lessons learned from completed deliveries
tasks.description: Capture lessons learned from completed deliveries; done when lessons recorded.

tasks.name: Capture retrospective knowledge outputs
tasks.description: Capture knowledge outputs from retrospectives for team consumption; done when outputs recorded.

tasks.name: Categorize service request
tasks.description: Categorize the service request by type, priority, and fulfilling team assignment. Done when the request carries all classification attributes.

tasks.name: Check demand for duplicates against backlog
tasks.description: Run a duplicate and overlap check for the demand against the existing backlog. Done when duplicates or overlaps are identified.

tasks.name: Collect developer satisfaction scores
tasks.description: Collect developer satisfaction scores. Done when scores are gathered.

tasks.name: Communicate demand intake decision
tasks.description: Communicate the demand intake decision, status, and prioritization outcome to requesting stakeholders. Done when communication is sent.

tasks.name: Conduct peer code review
tasks.description: Conduct peer code review on the pull request and address feedback before merge. Done when review approval is obtained.

tasks.name: Conduct performance and load testing
tasks.description: Perform performance and load testing on high-traffic or latency-sensitive components. Done when results are captured against targets.

tasks.name: Conduct security vulnerability scanning
tasks.description: Run security and vulnerability scans using SAST and DAST tooling. Done when scan results are reviewed.

tasks.name: Conduct streaming load testing
tasks.description: Conduct load testing to validate stream throughput and latency targets under peak conditions. Done when targets are validated.

tasks.name: Configure delivery-semantics handling
tasks.description: Configure exactly-once processing and late-arrival handling for the stream. Done when semantics behave as specified.

tasks.name: Configure pipeline DAG schedules and triggers
tasks.description: Configure DAGs/workflow definitions, schedules, triggers, and SLAs for batch and event-driven executions. Done when configuration is applied.

tasks.name: Configure test environments
tasks.description: Configure test environments for QA execution. Done when environments are provisioned and validated.

tasks.name: Confirm demand funding and capacity
tasks.description: Confirm funding and capacity availability before progressing the demand to analysis. Done when both are confirmed.

tasks.name: Confirm sprint capacity
tasks.description: Confirm team capacity for the sprint.

tasks.name: Confirm sprint commitment feasibility
tasks.description: Validate feasibility against resource capacity and team velocity.

tasks.name: Confirm team composition and environments
tasks.description: Confirm team composition and environment readiness. Done when both are verified.

tasks.name: Coordinate SME knowledge contributions
tasks.description: Coordinate subject-matter expert contributions to keep specialist knowledge current; done when contributions captured.

tasks.name: Coordinate schema evolution
tasks.description: Coordinate schema evolution with producers and consumers via backward-compatible contract changes. Done when changes are agreed and compatible.

tasks.name: Curate engineering knowledge base
tasks.description: Curate and maintain the engineering knowledge base of patterns, decisions, reusable code samples, and lessons learned; done when base updated.

tasks.name: Decompose epics into sprint-ready user stories
tasks.description: Break epics into sprint-ready user stories.

tasks.name: Define documentation requirements for components
tasks.description: Define documentation requirements for new or changed system components. Done when requirements are documented.

tasks.name: Define release test plan
tasks.description: Define the test strategy and plan for the release, covering scope and risk areas. Done when plan is approved.

tasks.name: Define sprint goal
tasks.description: Set the sprint goal for the upcoming sprint.

tasks.description: Define the streaming topology and event schema contracts. Done when topology and contracts are specified.

tasks.name: Define streaming use case requirements
tasks.description: Define streaming use case requirements including latency, throughput, and ordering guarantees. Done when requirements are agreed.

tasks.name: Deliver engineering onboarding program

tasks.description: Deploy orchestration definitions through the version-controlled change management process. Done when definitions are deployed.

tasks.name: Develop and deliver integration
tasks.description: Build the integration components and deliver them into the target environment. Done when integration is deployed and functional.

tasks.name: Document event topology

tasks.description: Document functional and non-functional requirements covering performance, security, and availability targets. Done when specification is complete.

tasks.description: Draft the documentation set: solution design documents, API specifications, and runbooks. Done when drafts are complete.

tasks.name: Escalate high-priority demand items

tasks.name: Estimate effort for backlog items
tasks.description: Size effort for backlog items ahead of prioritization.

tasks.description: Run the integration and system test cycle against the build. Done when cycle completes with recorded results.

tasks.name: Execute test cases against release candidate
tasks.description: Execute functional regression and new-feature test cases against the release candidate. Done when results are recorded.

tasks.name: Execute user acceptance testing

tasks.name: Facilitate current-state discovery workshops
tasks.description: Run workshops with subject-matter experts to capture current-state process and pain points. Done when findings are documented.

tasks.name: Facilitate engineering communities of practice

tasks.name: Facilitate engineering retrospectives
tasks.description: Facilitate engineering retrospectives; done when retrospective held.

tasks.name: Facilitate requirements elicitation workshop
tasks.description: Run an elicitation workshop with business stakeholders and subject-matter experts to gather requirements. Done when outputs are captured.

tasks.name: Gather assurance review evidence

tasks.name: Gather requirements with stakeholders
tasks.description: Gather and clarify requirements with the product owner and subject-matter experts. Done when requirements are agreed.

tasks.description: Produce API and interface reference documentation and validate accuracy before go-live. Done when validated reference docs are ready.

tasks.description: Identify dependencies on other systems, teams, or external services for the capability. Done when the dependency list is documented.

tasks.name: Identify knowledge gaps

tasks.description: Incorporate developer feedback into platform improvement cycles. Done when feedback is actioned into backlog.

tasks.name: Integrate components with dependent services

tasks.name: Maintain internal developer portal

tasks.name: Maintain system inventory
tasks.description: Maintain system inventory with component ownership, version, and dependency data; done when inventory current.

tasks.description: Model the process and data flows for the proposed solution. Done when flow diagrams are documented and reviewed.

tasks.description: Monitor run status, queue depths, and SLA breach alerts and reconcile completeness in real time. Done when monitoring is active.

tasks.description: Monitor consumer lag, partition utilization, and end-to-end latency in real time. Done when telemetry is observable.

tasks.description: Obtain QA sign-off confirming the release candidate meets exit criteria for deployment. Done when sign-off is recorded.

tasks.name: Obtain architecture sign-off before deployment
tasks.description: Obtain architecture sign-off on implementation fitness before production deployment. Done when sign-off is granted.

tasks.name: Obtain product owner acceptance sign-off
tasks.description: Obtain product owner acceptance sign-off before the release candidate is cut. Done when sign-off is recorded.

tasks.name: Obtain product owner sign-off on backlog
tasks.description: Secure product owner sign-off on the prioritized backlog and sprint commitment.

tasks.name: Obtain sign-off on elaborated scope
tasks.description: Secure formal stakeholder sign-off on the elaborated scope. Done when approval is recorded.

tasks.name: Onboard new team members using system knowledge
tasks.description: Onboard new team members using documented system knowledge and runbooks; done when onboarding completed.

tasks.name: Operate API gateway and middleware
tasks.description: Run and maintain API gateway and middleware components including routing, policies, and health. Done when services are stable and monitored.

tasks.name: Prepare test data sets
tasks.description: Prepare test data sets required for QA execution. Done when representative data is available.

tasks.description: Create architecture decision records capturing rationale for significant design choices. Done when ADRs are documented.

tasks.description: Produce the test summary report covering defect metrics and outstanding risk items. Done when report is issued.

tasks.description: Promote the build artifact to test or staging environment for formal QA and UAT. Done when artifact is deployed.

tasks.name: Propose delivery approach for prioritization discussion
tasks.description: Recommend a delivery approach for the prioritization discussion.

tasks.name: Provision self-service developer environment templates
tasks.description: Provision self-service developer environment templates. Done when templates are available to teams.

tasks.name: Publish contracts to schema registry
tasks.description: Publish event schema contracts to the schema registry for producer/consumer alignment. Done when contracts are registered.

tasks.name: Publish developer experience metrics dashboard
tasks.description: Measure and publish the developer experience and engineering metrics dashboard. Done when dashboard is live.

tasks.name: Publish documentation to developer portal
tasks.description: Publish documentation to the internal developer portal or knowledge base. Done when documentation is accessible to consumers.

tasks.name: Publish sprint plan to stakeholders
tasks.description: Publish sprint plan and backlog status to stakeholders via the delivery tracking tool.

tasks.name: Rank backlog items
tasks.description: Rank the backlog by value, risk, and dependency order.

tasks.description: Review and re-prioritize the backlog on cadence to incorporate new demand and changing priorities.

tasks.name: Review non-functional requirement compliance
